purpose: Bind each defense-demo patient to the clinical CSV, synthetic genotype TXT, behavior-day scenario, and expected fusion-output artifact used by the HealthAI Platform demo flow.
boundaries: Clinical profiles are Synthea-derived demo profiles with NHANES-style supplemental fields.
Genotype files are synthetic 23andMe-style demo files generated from local GWAS weight files; they are not real personal genomes.
Behavior timelines are simulated_demo artifacts; they are not real wearable, IoT, camera, or device evidence.
Expected fusion results are local demo outputs for rehearsal, not clinical validation.

patients.display_name: 代谢与糖尿病高风险主线患者
patients.demo_story: 临床血压和代谢指标异常，基因层面强化代谢与心血管风险，行为时间线显示短睡眠、高碳水、高钠和久坐。
patients.recommended_use: 8-10 分钟答辩主流程首选患者

patients.display_name: 心血管与心衰监测备用患者
patients.demo_story: 临床上突出心血管和肾功能压力，基因层面强化血压、冠心病和心衰风险，行为时间线展示钠摄入和活动耐量受限。
patients.recommended_use: 备用患者；适合展示慢病管理、心血管监测和药物安全模块

patients.display_name: 年轻心代谢与呼吸改善对照患者
patients.demo_story: 临床仍有血压和代谢压力，但行为时间线更健康，基因层面突出呼吸/炎症与中等心代谢易感性，适合作为对照故事。
patients.recommended_use: 对照患者；适合展示改善型生活方式和个性化建议
